content.text: Yes, `-p` is short for `--project` in the Vitest 5.0.3 installed here. I checked the CLI option definitions in `node_modules/vitest/dist/chunks/cac.DfDGTQ9W.js:1131`, which set `shorthand: "p"` on `project`. Like `--project`, you can repeat it to select several projects (for example, `vitest -p api -p web`). It also takes wildcards (`-p "packages*"`) and `!` to exclude projects. Vitest 4 and earlier don't have this shorthand, so use `--project` there.
